title: Regenerated sprites.json order (small_biz/campus before pucks) mismatches the renderer's positional bbox binding
detail: Next script run writes order[6..10] = small_biz, campus, puck_1..3, but the renderer pins puck_1..3, small_biz, campus at files[6..10]; parse checks only length, so five sprites silently bind wrong bboxes and sprite_puck_target's tier base corrupts.
recommended_fix: Append puck names before small_biz/campus in main() to match files[]; or make sprites_parse_boxes verify order[i] equals the pinned files[i] name before binding.

title: Sculpted fold-in path unsupported: main() always re-renders and overwrites exported PNGs; no bbox-only mode or .blend import
detail: The sculpted flow needs bbox regen without re-render, but main() unconditionally renders every sprite from SPEC geometry before reading bboxes — running it overwrites the user's exported assets/sprites/ PNGs.
recommended_fix: Add a bbox-only mode (recompute content_bbox from existing PNGs, skip build_*), or document that fold-in means translating sculpted geometry into the SPEC table.

title: PUCK_TIER[ports] direct index + duplicated {4:1,8:2,16:3} literals: KeyError / three-way sync trap on SPEC edits
evidence:
tools/gen_sprites.py:61:
PUCK_TIER      = {4: 1.0, 8: 1.15, 16: 1.30}   # tier size ladder (keep)
 | tools/gen_sprites.py:284:
    r = PUCK_R * PUCK_TIER[ports]
 | tools/gen_sprites.py:329-331:
    for ports in (4, 8, 16):
        build_puck(ports, "puck_%d" % {4: 1, 8: 2, 16: 3}[ports])
        names.append("puck_%d" % {4: 1, 8: 2, 16: 3}[ports])
detail: Direct PUCK_TIER[ports] indexing raises KeyError for any ports outside {4,8,16}; a tier edit must also update two hard-coded naming maps. No guard on the invited SPEC edit surface.
recommended_fix: Single-source the map: enumerate PUCK_TIER's keys to derive name/index (sorted), or validate ports against PUCK_TIER at build_puck entry with a clear error.

title: mat_hex silently mis-parses wrong-length SPEC hexes (slices, no length check)
evidence:
tools/gen_sprites.py:92-93:
    h = hex_color.lstrip("#")
    rgba = (_lin(int(h[0:2], 16) * shade), _lin(int(h[2:4], 16) * shade), _lin(int(h[4:6], 16) * shade), 1.0)
 | tools/gen_sprites.py:69:
HOST_FILL       = "#3E78D0"    # deep blue (KYLE: #4682B4)
 | tools/gen_sprites.py:34:
EDIT THE SILHOUETTE SPEC BELOW (the fill-in-the-blanks surface), re-run.
detail: A 5- or 7-digit SPEC hex parses partially without error (e.g. trailing 'D' becomes 13), silently rendering wrong colors that the follow-up T2 re-bless would bless as golden.
recommended_fix: Validate the hex in mat_hex before slicing: assert len(h)==6 after lstrip and hex-digit parse; reject malformed SPEC colors loudly.
